description: The office of Congresswoman Sydney Kamlager-Dove (CA-37) seeks to hire an experienced Caseworker for the Los Angeles District Office (MidCity/Wilshire) in a full-time capacity. The Caseworker plays an integral role by serving as a liaison to the federal government on behalf of the Member's constituents. The Caseworker will handle a portfolio that includes, but is not limited to, the State Department/Passports/Non-Immigration Visas, IRS, Social Security Administration, Health & Human Services, CMS, FEMA, Dept of Transportation, Dept of Education, and Dept of Labor on behalf of the Member. The Caseworker will work closely with the District Director, Field Representatives, and other Caseworkers to provide outstanding service to the Member's constituents. As a first-term Member office, we are looking for a proactive, solutions-oriented individual who can work alongside the rest of the District Office staff to help create and fine-tune our processes. This job requires the ability to execute multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Our team values honesty, professionalism, and kindness.

Work closely with the District Director, Field Representatives, and other Caseworkers to provide outstanding service to constituents
Answer written casework correspondence as well as phone and in-person communications with constituents
Create and fine-tune office processes alongside District Office staff
Table at local events to inform the community that the office is available as a resource
Answer phones and greet visitors
Assist with administrative items
Staff and drive the Member
Perform other duties as assigned

Previous casework experience preferred
Knowledge of the Hill preferred
Ability to execute multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
Ability to prioritize and follow through on time-sensitive requests
Discretion and empathy are essential
Proactive, solutions-oriented individual
